name: Fractera Blocks
shortDescription: The registry of page blocks: every block as source code with its dependencies, served the shadcn way (API) and as commands for an agent (MCP).
longDescription: The shadcn registry of the node blocks: /r/registry.json and /r/<name>.json (npx shadcn add @fractera/<name>), pictures in /r/assets/*, an MCP for agents (/mcp: list_blocks, search_blocks, get_block, install_instructions), and a site that shows every block — the catalogue home, the showcase /showcase/<lang>/<section> and the guide. The blocks themselves live in registry/src and are built by shadcn build into registry-out/.
accepts: Nothing to read the registry; the node key (X-Settings-Key) for its own design door.
returns: Registry items in the shadcn format; block lists and instructions over MCP.
